### Standing On Your Mission Field
Author: Noelle Dey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-june-27-2016.html
Passage: Matthew 10:42
Points:
- Believers often feel a nagging urge to pursue grand mission work in distant places.
- God's primary calling frequently begins with the specific people placed directly in our care.
- Everyday acts of faithful care within the home serve as genuine ministry.
- We must learn faithfulness in small, local responsibilities before seeking larger platforms.

### What Serving God Must Be
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/church-leaders/what-serving-god-must-be
Passage: Matthew 10:42
Points:
- People often fear Christian service because they assume it requires extreme or dangerous sacrifice.
- Most of God's demands on us are smaller, everyday calls to humble unselfishness.
- Faithful servanthood is proven in ordinary tasks like caring for family or assisting a neighbor.
- Even the smallest gesture done in Jesus' name carries eternal significance and guaranteed reward.
